name: Déclaration européenne de services (DES) – TVA intracommunautaire
author: Long Watch Studio - Code Faeries

sections.description:
Export your French European Services Declaration (DES) from your WooCommerce orders. The plugin reads your orders and gives you the XML file to submit to the French customs service: last month in one click, or the month of your choice.

The European Services Declaration (DES, “Déclaration européenne de services”) is filed online by French companies that sell services to businesses in other EU member states. It is generally due within the first 12 days of each month. Preparing it by hand means going back through every intra-community sale of the month. This plugin does that reading for you.

Access the customs declaration service (douane.gouv.fr)

Who is it for?

You are a French company, you sell services to another EU member state, and your store runs on WooCommerce.

Features

  • DES XML file – Download the XML exchange file to submit to French customs: last month in one click, or a month and year of your choice
  • Built from your WooCommerce orders – Completed, processing and refunded orders without VAT that carry a customer VAT number (French and UK numbers excluded)
  • CSV detail – Download one row per order or refund behind the XML file, to check each total in your spreadsheet
  • One line per customer VAT number – Amounts excluding tax are added up per VAT number and rounded to whole numbers, as the file format requires
  • Refunds deducted – A refund is deducted in the month it is made
  • Works with your VAT number plugin – Reads the customer VAT number from the _billing_eu_vat_number, _vat_number or _billing_vat_number order fields
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatible (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • Developer filters – Order statuses, excluded countries, VAT number fields and file name can be changed by filter

Your data stays on your site

The plugin does not use any third-party system. Everything runs locally on your website.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open WooCommerce > Déclaration DES and enter your French intra-community VAT number.
  3. Download last month’s file, or tick “Ou choisir une autre période” and pick a month and a year.
  4. Upload the file on the customs online DES service.

DES Pro

  • Customer VAT number field at checkout – Checked by format, then by the European Commission’s VIES service; a business customer from another member state is then exempted from VAT (reverse charge)
  • Monthly email – The DES file sent automatically by email each month
  • Reminders – A monthly reminder in your admin
  • Documents – Generated files kept on your site and listed, with the file name format of your choice
  • Statistics – Amounts declared per country in a chart, several periods compared
  • Your own VAT number fields – Set the order meta keys your VAT number plugin uses

More about DES Pro

Do you use this plugin?

A review on wordpress.org helps other French stores find it: leave a review. Thank you.
sections.installation:
This section explains how to install and configure the plugin.
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/codefaeries-declaration-des directory, or install it directly from the WordPress admin interface.
2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress “Plugins” interface.
3. Use the interface from WooCommerce > Déclaration DES to configure the extension.
sections.faq:
What is the DES (European Services Declaration)?

The “Déclaration européenne de services” is the declaration French companies file with French customs for the services they sell to businesses in other EU member states. It is generally due within the first 12 days of each month.

Which orders are included?

Completed, processing and refunded orders of the period, without VAT, with a total other than zero, that carry a customer VAT number. Numbers starting with FR or GB are left out. Refunds are deducted in the month they are made.

Can the plugin submit the declaration for me?

No. The French tax authorities do not offer a publicly available API to submit a European Services Declaration automatically. The submission goes through the Prodouane online service, where you import the XML file generated by the plugin.

Does the plugin add a VAT number field to my checkout?

The free version does not: many plugins already do this very well, and this plugin uses the VAT numbers they collect. If it cannot read them, contact our support. DES Pro adds an optional field, checked with the European Commission’s VIES service.

Does it need WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin works with WooCommerce orders.

Does it support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, High-Performance Order Storage is supported.

Is my data sent anywhere?

No. The free plugin does not use any third-party system: everything runs locally on your website.

Where do I configure it?

In WooCommerce > Déclaration DES.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Fixed: the Pro tabs now show what they bring instead of an empty page
  • Compatibility: DES Pro 1.0.6 adds the customer VAT number field at checkout, checked with VIES

1.0.5

  • New: download the declaration detail as a CSV file, one row per order or refund included in the XML, to check what each total is made of
  • New: a warning on the plugin page when the store currency is not the euro, as the DES amounts are not converted
  • Fixed: the custom period and Pro feature labels were in English on a French page
  • Fixed: the tabs no longer overflow the screen on a phone

1.0.4

  • Fixed: the custom period month field accepts 1 to 12
  • Fixed: WP-CLI no longer stops on a site where WP_DEBUG is on and the plugin is active
  • Improved: “View any period” is no longer listed among the Pro features, the free plugin already offers it
  • Improved: new plugin title, tags, description and FAQ
  • Compatibility: tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3

1.0.3

  • Tag – WooCommerce 10.8

1.0.0

  • Initial release
